title: Altinity SQL Browser stored workspace v3
description: One independently addressable browser-persistence aggregate with immutable application and URL identities, an ordered saved-query collection, and an ordered collection of Dashboard documents. Supersedes stored-workspace-v2, whose singular zero-or-one `dashboard` field becomes the required `dashboards` array; v2 records remain readable and migrate deterministically on read. Internal persistence contract; portable interchange uses portable-bundle-v1 instead.

storageVersion.title: Storage version
storageVersion.description: Stored-workspace contract version; always 3 for this contract. Unknown future versions fail closed.

id.title: Workspace identifier
id.description: Stable generated application identity. Two workspaces with the same display name still have distinct IDs.

key.title: Workspace URL key
key.description: Stable lowercase ASCII identity used by workspace URLs. It is immutable after creation and unique case-insensitively within the local repository.

name.title: Workspace name
name.description: Mutable user-visible workspace name. Renaming it does not change the workspace ID, URL key, or any Dashboard title.

queries.title: Saved queries
queries.description: The ordered saved-query collection in catalog/authoring order, independent of Dashboard tile order. Required even when empty.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: This workspace's Dashboard documents in canonical workspace Dashboard order: [] for none, one entry for the current common case, several once multi-Dashboard selection ships. Dashboard IDs are unique within the workspace; tile, filter, and layout placement IDs stay Dashboard-local. The bound matches the portable-bundle Dashboard capacity rather than introducing a second one. Required even when empty.
